scripts.sync: pnpm --filter @cozypad/desktop build && pnpm --filter @cozypad/app build && cap sync android && node scripts/copy-agent-host.mjs
scripts.sync:ios: pnpm --filter @cozypad/desktop build && pnpm --filter @cozypad/app build && node scripts/copy-ios-agent-host.mjs && cap sync ios
scripts.apk:release:unsigned: pnpm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.apk:debug: pnpm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
